name: Film Noir
source:
Nowadays video cameras are more popular than 8 mm films and rival video school club gets all the attention. In these circumstances Mayu Natsu is  struggling to gather performers and staff in order to shoot his own independent film before he graduates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
如今，摄像机比8毫米胶片更普及，学校里与电影部相抗衡的录像部也备受瞩目。在这种境况下，岩井真由夏正努力召集演员和工作人员，希望能在毕业前拍摄自己的独立电影。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
